title: 12-Lead ECG
author: A. Brennan, MD
summary: Sinus tachycardia 118, PR 148 ms, QRS 88 ms, QTc 428 ms. Tall, narrow, peaked T waves V2-V4 (correlate with potassium).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 118 bpm. PR 148 ms. QRS 88 ms. QT/QTc 305/428 ms.

**Interpretation**
Sinus tachycardia. Tall, narrow, symmetric ("tented") T waves, most obvious in V2 to V4. PR and QRS are normal and P waves are present: no signs of severe hyperkalemia (no wide QRS, no loss of P waves). No ST elevation. Correlate with the potassium level (drawn 0406).
impression: Sinus tachycardia 118 with peaked T waves V2-V4, consistent with hyperkalemia. Normal PR and QRS.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: R. Delacroix, MD
summary: Sinus rhythm 94, PR 152 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 432 ms. T waves normal; the peaked T waves of 0425 have resolved.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 94 bpm. PR 152 ms. QRS 86 ms. QT/QTc 345/432 ms.

**Interpretation**
Normal sinus rhythm. T waves now normal in height and shape in V2 to V4. Compared with 0425: heart rate slower (118 to 94) and the peaked T waves have resolved (potassium 6.0 to 4.9).
impression: Normal sinus rhythm 94. Peaked T waves resolved. Normal ECG.
